WITH order_counts AS (
  SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) as order_count
  FROM `order`
  GROUP BY account_id
),
overall_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(order_count) as avg_orders
  FROM order_counts
),
above_avg AS (
  SELECT oc.account_id, oc.order_count
  FROM order_counts oc, overall_avg oa
  WHERE oc.order_count > oa.avg_orders
),
above_avg_avg AS (
  SELECT AVG(order_count) as above_avg_mean
  FROM above_avg
)
SELECT 
  aa.account_id,
  aa.order_count,
  aa.order_count - oa.avg_orders,
  aa.order_count - aaa.above_avg_mean
FROM above_avg aa, overall_avg oa, above_avg_avg aaa
ORDER BY (aa.order_count - aaa.above_avg_mean) DESC
LIMIT 10
